title: Science of wellbeing
learning_outcomes: Explain affect satisfaction meaning in the context of science of wellbeing.
Compare and distinguish research measures in the context of science of wellbeing.
Apply causal limits in the context of science of wellbeing.
Evaluate and justify decisions about wellbeing reflection in the context of science of wellbeing.

lessons.title: Affect satisfaction meaning
lessons.outcome: Explain affect satisfaction meaning in the context of science of wellbeing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving affect satisfaction meaning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to research critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain affect satisfaction meaning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of affect satisfaction meaning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Research measures
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish research measures in the context of science of wellbeing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving research measures; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to research critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain research measures from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of research measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Causal limits
lessons.outcome: Apply causal limits in the context of science of wellbeing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving causal limits; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to research critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain causal limits from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of causal limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Wellbeing reflection
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about wellbeing reflection in the context of science of wellbeing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving wellbeing reflection; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to research critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain wellbeing reflection from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of wellbeing reflection; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of affect satisfaction meaning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of research measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of causal limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of wellbeing reflection; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
